users.description: One row per account; supports future multiple-user use.

boards.description: One board per user in the MVP.

columns.user_id: TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.title: TEXT NOT NULL

columns.description: Ordered, renameable columns belonging to a board.

columns.board_id: TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.title: TEXT NOT NULL

cards.description: Cards are ordered within a column and board.
constraints: FOREIGN KEY(board_id) REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY(board_id, column_id) REFERENCES columns(board_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE

auth_sessions.description: Persistent browser sessions; store only a digest of a random session token, never the raw token.

columns.user_id: TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

relationships: A user has at most one board.
A board has ordered columns and each column has ordered cards.
A user can have multiple active sessions across browser instances.
